meta.title: The journey of QUO-0221 · Clafina
meta.description: Follow one sale through Clafina: a quote Tunde can answer, an invoice that writes itself, a waybill signed at the door, and books that post themselves.

hero.title: The journey of QUO-0221
hero.lede: One quotation, eleven moments, five people and a van. Follow forty cartons of tomato paste from Ada's laptop to Tunde's shop, and watch every paper write the next one by itself.

chapters.title: Ada writes a quote
chapters.text: Tunde from Lagoon Foods wants forty cartons of tomato paste. Ada picks the item, Clafina fills in the price, the VAT and how long the offer stands. One minute, no spreadsheet.

chapters.title: Sealed, and on its way
chapters.text: The quote folds into its envelope and flies to Tunde as a link, by email or a chat app. He does not need an account to open it.

chapters.title: Tunde names his own price
chapters.text: Tunde can accept, or answer with his own price on the same page. He offers ₦29,000 a carton instead of ₦31,000. Every offer is kept, line by line.

chapters.title: A deal in five minutes
chapters.text: ₦29,000 is inside Ada's discount limit, so she accepts on the spot. Above her limit, it would have gone to Ngozi first. The quote is stamped agreed.

chapters.title: The invoice writes itself
chapters.text: One tap turns the agreed quote into invoice INV-0412, with a Pay now link inside. Nobody types the lines again, so nothing is mistyped.

chapters.title: Ngozi approves the order
chapters.text: Sales order SO-0187 asks for approval because it is a large one. Ngozi checks Lagoon Foods' credit on her phone, it is clear, and she approves from a meeting.

chapters.title: Femi picks and packs
chapters.text: The order appears on Femi's pick list in the warehouse. He scans forty cartons; Main store drops from 120 to 80 as each one leaves the shelf.

chapters.title: Musa takes the road
chapters.text: Waybill WB-0097 goes with the load. Ada and Tunde can both see it move. Send it in the van, or on a bike for a small order: try the switch above the scene.

chapters.title: Signed at the door
chapters.text: Tunde counts forty cartons and signs on Musa's phone. Name, time and signature are kept on the waybill, so there is never a "we never got it".

chapters.title: Tunde pays from the invoice
chapters.text: Tunde opens INV-0412 and taps Pay now. The money reaches Bright Harbour Traders and Clafina matches it to the invoice by itself.

chapters.title: A receipt, and the books agree
chapters.text: In the same minute the receipt goes to Tunde and the books are posted: sales, VAT, the bank, and Lagoon Foods owing nothing. Six papers, one record, and nobody typed anything twice.

cta.title: Run your next sale like this
cta.body: Start free and send your first quotation as a link today.
